thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE — Potential KV cache cross-tenant exposure detected for customer 7102 (VPC/dedicated). Severity: P1. Observed intermittent prefix reuse between nv-pool-9 and vpc-7102; possible cross-tenant reads. Pager -> @oncall-rotation. Root TS: 1712236800

nora-sre: Paging in. I'm taking lead. Who's on-call for runtime?

raj: @nora-sre I'm oncall for runtime (raj). Allocated to investigate routing table + pool assignments for nv-pool-9. Starting packet capture, will confirm spill paths.

elaine-cs: CS on standby. Customer 7102 (Medline Inc) reporting JSON payloads appearing in unrelated logs. They saw 3 request IDs with wrong namespace: req-3af4, req-3af7, req-3b01.

mike-eng: grabbing KV cache stats. Running quick query:
```
SELECT key_prefix, tenant_id, count(*) FROM kv_cache_logs WHERE timestamp > now() - '10m' GROUP BY 1,2;
```

mike-eng: seeing repeated prefix 'acct/medline' mapped to tenant 7102 and tenant 1984 intermittently.

sara-te: can we firewall nv-pool-9? Is there a quick mitigation to isolate?

raj: I'm switching the pool to quarantine mode (no cross-tenant reuse) — applying policy change now:
```
redwoodctl pool set nv-pool-9 --tenant-isolation enforce --drain-conns
```

raj: applied. Starting drain. Propagation may be 30-60s.

incident-bot: Note: Auto-fallback triggered — new requests for model redwood-7b were routed to redwood-7b-compat while pool drains.

nora-sre: Good. Elaine, ask customer to pause traffic for 5 mins if possible. We need samples (headers, tenant header) and affected request ids.

elaine-cs: Sent message asking them to pause. They replied they can throttle for 10 mins. Sending samples now.

mike-eng: Got sample payloads. The HTTP headers show X-Tenant: 7102 in the body, but connection metadata had tenant 1984. Looks like routing layer didn't apply tenant scoping for a subset of requests from dedicated pool nodes.

sara-te: Any hotfix for routing? Is this config drift or a code change?

raj: Initial diff shows a recently merged autoscaler change that added a 'reuse_kv_cache' flag default true for dedicated pools to reduce cost. That flag didn't respect VPC tenant scoping when activating pooled caches.

nora-sre: Rollback plan?

raj: Rolling back flag for nv-pool-9 and triggering config redeploy:
```
redwoodctl config rollback --pool nv-pool-9 --key reuse_kv_cache
```

raj: rollback complete. Cache entries being invalidated now.

mike-eng: Invalidated ~12k keys. Monitoring logs for cross-tenant reads.

incident-bot: SLA Impact: Potential exposure window ~00:08:00. Affected tenants: 7102 (confirmed), 1984 (observed writes). Severity downgraded to P2 after isolation.

elaine-cs: Customer confirmed they saw unrelated payloads but cannot confirm PII leak yet. Asking for more context and will set up incident bridge.

sara-te: I'm creating bridge — zoom.me/bridge/abc123

nora-sre: On bridge in 2. Please add legal and privacy.

mike-eng: Postmortem items so far: revert risky reuse flag; add tenant-scoped cache enforcement tests; alert on tenant-header mismatch; add canary to config rollout for reuse_kv_cache.

elaine-cs: Customer on bridge, they provided request bodies that include account_number redacted. We need deeper forensics.

raj: Dumped pool routing map at time of incident:
```
pool nv-pool-9 => nodes [g1,g2,g3]
g1: tenants [7102,1984]
```

raj: Hmm g1 still had stale routing config. Investigating how node g1 ingested old routing blob.

sara-te: Who pushed routing blob to g1 last? Trace it.

mike-eng: git log shows deployer svc pushed blob 2024-04-03T02:12:00Z. There's a race during redeploy where old blob may be reapplied if rollout ordering reverses.

nora-sre: Action items assigned: raj - forensics + root cause; mike - monitoring & keys invalidation verification; sara - rollout safety rules; elaine - customer comms. ETA 2 hours for initial incident report.

elaine-cs: Customer thanks team for quick isolation. They're asking for timeline and mitigation steps once we have them.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: labels=[kv-cache,tenant-isolation,dedicated-pool,vpc-7102]; incident_state=mitigated; incident_id=INC-20240403-71

nora-sre: Closing pager. Will hand off to follow-up channel: #postmortems. Please file follow-up with logs and sample artifacts.

mike-eng: I'll upload artifacts to the secure bucket and link: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-20240403-71/artifacts

elaine-cs: Sending customer an executive summary now.

raj: leaving notes in the config repo about safe defaults.

sara-te: thx all — will schedule follow-up review tomorrow 11am PT.

nora-sre: Great job. :thumbsup:
